digest.component_or_area: code review trigger routing and overlay framework
propositions: The rebar project exhibits high trigger over-fire (35.3% combined fire rate) due to concurrency-related vocabulary that must live in the project overlay rather than the committed high-precision tier
Three corpus bugs (fine-wisteria-solenodon, fervid-boring-python, eclectic-spotted-barb) trigger only through noisy-tier concurrency tokens and are undetectable by committed-only routing
The two-layer trigger design (committed high-precision tier + project-specific noisy tier) lacks documentation, preventing other projects from replicating the pattern
A project overlay entry in criteria_routing.json using trigger_tokens and applies_to must be added with concurrency-specific vocabulary to make the corpus bugs detectable
Measurement and documentation must demonstrate the fire-rate tradeoff (13.3% committed vs +22.0% noisy) and provide a reproducible test to verify the routing behavior changes with the project overlay
